data.one_liner: Collection of Dart and Flutter extensions for context, primitive variables, and common utilities.
data.what_it_does: Kartal provides 16 type extensions and built-in utilities accessible via a clean .ext syntax. It covers BuildContext helpers, string manipulation, responsive sizing, form validations, device information, and navigation.
use_when: You want a single utility package to handle responsive sizing, padding, and screen breakpoints.
You need convenient extension methods on primitive types like String, int, DateTime, and BuildContext.
avoid_when: You prefer keeping your extension methods minimal and write your own to avoid bringing in a large external dependency.
strengths: Extensive collection of type extensions for primitives, futures, lists, files, colors, and more.
Built-in responsive sizing, padding, and device screen breakpoints.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
weaknesses: Brings in multiple dependencies like device_info_plus, dio, share_plus, and url_launcher which may be unnecessary if you only need a small subset of features.
data.minimal_example:
Container(
  padding: context.padding.low,
  height: context.sized.dynamicHeight(0.1),
  child: Text(
    'Hello',
    style: context.general.textTheme.titleMedium,
  ),
)
